recruiterCard.organization: Space Science and Engineering Center, UW-Madison
recruiterCard.summary: Supports research computing operations across scientific environments, blending technical support, infrastructure work, and systems reliability for NASA- and NOAA-adjacent workflows.
impactBullets: Resolved Linux, Windows, and macOS issues for research staff supporting scientific computing workflows.
Diagnosed hardware, software, and network failures to minimize downtime for data and simulation environments.
Assisted users with command-line tools, file systems, and permissions on shared research computing resources.
Documented solutions and escalated complex issues to systems administrators to improve long-term reliability.
